title: Bloxtension
tagline: Easily navigate addresses, transaction hashes and more on the web using blockscout and 1inch.
description:
We've created a browser extension to easily retrieve information about addresses, contracts and transactions while browsing the web without having to go through the process of coping and going to a blockchain explorer - saving users time.
The extension integrates with blockscout SDK to show users reliable information, allowing them to configure the chains and data they're interested in.
how_its_made: We've used the Plasmo framework for building the extension (first class React framework, offers Message and Storage API support for both Chrome and Firefox) and Blockscout APIs for data retrieval. We're also utilising the Blockscout SDK for transaction summaries with LLMs. The whole project is written in typescript.
